[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Status effects[/h2]
Bleed and Poison damage is too high, making the strategies that abuse them too overpowered. With these changes, they will still be strong, but not as dominant. There might be additional changes to these status effects in future patches, but it's better to do them gradually to see how they affect the game first.

[list]
[*] Damage per stack: 3% of max health >>> [b]2.5% of max health[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Poison[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: v1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A new combat type has been added to the game, Horde![/b] Hordes have many more enemies than usual, but they are significantly weaker! Defeat them all to win!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b19wfev.png[/img]

[b]Enemies in hordes have:[/b]
[list]
[*] 60% less health
[*] 50% less attack, intellect, defense, and spirit
[*] 25% less speed
[*] 2 less movement range (down to a minimum of 1)
[/list]
[b]Hordes have a ~10% chance of appearing instead of normal combats, and they give +25% crystals after winning.[/b] In Hordes, more than one of the same enemy can spawn (except Battlemages).

[*] [b]Enemies attracted with cards such as Enrage or Taunt now go over spikes instead of avoiding them.[/b] Make them bleed!
[*] A button to join the official discord has been added in the bottom right corner of the main menu.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Combat Types[/h2]
[h3]Pick up combat items to win![/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The amount of combat items needed to win has been reduced:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sector 1: 4 [i](unchanged)[/i]
[*] Sector 2: 8 >>> [b]6[/b]
[*] Sector 3: 12 >>> [b]8[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Now gives +75% crystals after winning instead of +50%[/b]
[*] Starting enemy team difficulty (compared to normal combats): -20% >>> [b]-30%[/b]
[*] Combat items spawned at the end of each turn: 2 >>> [b]3[/b]
[*] Chance of appearing instead of normal combats: ~10% >>> [b]~6%[/b]
[/list]

If you like the game, please consider leaving a review, it really helps a lot! [b]Thank you for playing the game and for the support![/b] I'll be closely monitoring all feedback in order to make the game the best it can be. If you notice any kind of bugs, please let me know!

notes.title: v1.2.1

[h3]Level Ups[/h3]
Some small clarifications regarding the following balance changes:
[olist]
[*] The upgrade amount for each stat when leveling up is now calculated this way: min(minimum upgrade value, [b]5%[/b] of the class default stat value)
[*] Previous to this patch the calculation was min(minimum upgrade value, [b]10%[/b] of the class default stat value)
[*] min() means the minimum number between the two values.
[*] The minimum upgrade values depend on each stat and are listed below.
[*] The class default value refers to the stat's default value before any Soul Stone upgrades.
[*] In short, this is intended to be a nerf to the amount of stats obtained when leveling up, with the intention of making them a bit less determinant in the character's progression through a run.
[/olist]

notes.title: early access v1.1
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Brawl Tactics: Origins first Early Access patch![/b] Improving many things from day 1! Let's see what's in store!

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]You can now view your deck while picking a card to add.[/b]
[*] [b]You can now move the camera with WASD and the arrow keys![/b]
[*] [b]Now non-stackable trinkets no longer appear if you already have them.[/b] Almost all trinkets stack, but there are a select few that don't.
[*] [b]The Forge has been considerably buffed.[/b] Upgrades cost less overall, their cost doesn't scale anymore for most of them and many give more stats.
[*] [b]Card rewards no longer appear naturally in normal combats.[/b] Just in elites and bosses for now [b]to reduce the excessive card item snowball until more cards get added[/b]. You can still find cards in events and shops, and normal combats still give crystals and level ups.
[*] Bug fix: Smoke Bomb's effect wears off in the same turn in which it was used, rendering it useless.
[*] Bug fix: The knockback effect of Heavy Impact could be used without paying mana.
[*] Bug fix: Rogue Dagger wasn't preventing evasion damage.
[/list]
